confidence_notes: Trinidad-specific 2026 menu prices were scarce, so food and drink anchors are bounded from Cuba-wide 2026 budget guides, aggregated price listings and Trinidad budget notes. Some sources are undated or use 2024-era peso prices, and mixed USD/EUR/CUP pricing plus a volatile informal exchange rate add uncertainty. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or listings were checked, and hostel anchors are least certain. Cocktail follows Trinidad budget figures of about 3 to 5 USD. Wine by the glass has no direct price data, so it is set at 1.5 times the beer anchor. FX was taken from RBA search results, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable foreign city was used. Trinidad is treated as a Cuban provincial colonial tourist town, with food and drink anchors set from Cuba-wide 2026 price ranges and Trinidad budget notes, plus a modest tourist premium. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Cuban casa particular and registered hotel pricing.
